svg.title: Builder
svg.desc: Builder. Assemble a complex object step by step and validate it once at the end, instead of calling a constructor with ten arguments. Step 1, Telescoping constructor: Seven positional arguments: null holds an unused slot, and swapping the two timeouts still compiles. Step 2, Build it step by step: Each call fills one part (json() also sets Content-Type), and build() returns a frozen Request. Step 3, Check once, at build(): build() checks the combination once: a GET with a body or no URL fails; the valid POST is frozen. Step 4, Same steps, two products: A Director runs one recipe on any Builder: RequestBuilder yields a Request, CurlBuilder a command.

g.text: Seven positional arguments: null holds an unused slot, and swapping the two timeouts still compiles.
Each call fills one part (json() also sets Content-Type), and build() returns a frozen Request.
build() checks the combination once: a GET with a body or no URL fails; the valid POST is frozen.
A Director runs one recipe on any Builder: RequestBuilder yields a Request, CurlBuilder a command.
swap null and 5000: it still compiles
null holds the place of an option you don't use.
One more option and the list grows to eight.
creates the Request from the parts,
no body on a GET or HEAD
new builder: the Director is unchanged
Every value is named; options you skip keep
their defaults, so no nulls and no bare true.
✗ Error: GET request cannot have a body
